name: Huffstutter Orchards
description: Huffstutter Orchards grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 621 State Route P, MO. The farm is family-run, and its seasons run through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
